description: This file contains Drupal system module hook implementations, including help, cron, file download, theme registry, and other system-related hooks, as well as class SystemHooks with methods implementing various Drupal hooks for system functionality.

classes.name: SystemHooks
classes.description: Contains implementations of various Drupal system hooks, managing system help, security advisories, file transfer, theme registry, cron tasks, and other core system functionalities.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help and informational content for various system routes, including documentation, module management, theme management, performance, cron, security advisories, and status reports.

methods.name: updaterInfo
methods.description: Returns information about update modules and themes for Drupal core updates.

methods.name: filetransferInfo
methods.description: Provides available file transfer backends such as FTP and SSH if supported.

methods.name: jsSettingsBuild
methods.description: Sets JavaScript settings for AJAX, including theme and library dependencies.

methods.name: jsSettingsAlter
methods.description: Alters JavaScript settings based on current request, including path info, theme token, and loaded libraries.

methods.name: systemInfoAlter
methods.description: Modifies system info, such as hiding certain regions for themes.

methods.name: cron
methods.description: Performs scheduled cleanup tasks like garbage collection, ensuring security directories have proper .htaccess files, and fetching security advisories.

methods.name: mail
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in email messages with tokens for subjects and bodies.

methods.name: entityTypeBuild
methods.description: Defines form classes and link templates for date format entity types.

methods.name: blockViewSystemMainBlockAlter
methods.description: Removes contextual links from the system main block to reduce clutter.

methods.name: elementInfoAlter
methods.description: Adds theme wrappers to page elements.

methods.name: modulesUninstalled
methods.description: Handles cleanup after module uninstallation, especially for workspaces.

methods.name: libraryInfoAlter
methods.description: Allows themes or modules to alter library info, e.g., for Claro theme override.

methods.name: themeRegistryAlter
methods.description: Alters theme registry, e.g., for Claro theme support.

methods.name: pageTop
methods.description: Displays security advisories and critical security announcements on admin pages.

methods.name: fileDownload
methods.description: Controls file download headers and access based on schemes.

methods.name: archiverInfoAlter
methods.description: Removes Zip archive support if PHP Zip extension is missing.

methods.name: systemEntityFormModePresave
methods.description: Transforms empty description fields into null for entities before save.
